We are looking for a cheerful barista to join our small team at Little Fern Coffee, a fictional cafe near the park. You will make espresso drinks and pour-overs, keep the counter and dishes clean, and take orders on our Square register. You should be comfortable working early mornings starting at 6 am and some weekends. Experience as a barista is great but we will train the right person. Food Safe certification is required within your first month. You need to be able to stay calm and friendly during the morning rush and work well with a small team. We offer tips, free drinks and flexible hours.
